# Beck Institute

> Beck Institute provides evidence-based CBT training, certification, and clinical services for mental health professionals and organizations worldwide.

Founded on principles of Cognitive Behavior Therapy by Dr. Aaron T. Beck, the Beck Institute offers comprehensive professional development programs, tiered certifications (from Clinician to Master Clinician to Supervisor), and direct therapy services through Beck Institute Cares. The organization specializes in CBT, Recovery-Oriented Cognitive Therapy (CT-R) for serious mental illness, and training for diverse populations including youth and individuals with ADHD and autism.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT)

## CBT Certification Programs

- [CBT Certification Overview](https://beckinstitute.org/certification): Beck Institute CBT Certification programs for clinicians at all levels.
- [CBT Certified Clinician (BICBT-CC)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certified-clinician): Beck Institute CBT Certified Clinician (BICBT-CC) certification pathway and requirements.
- [CBT Certified Master Clinician (BICBT-CMC)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certified-master-clinician): Beck Institute CBT Certified Master Clinician (BICBT-CMC) certification pathway.
- [CBT Certified Supervisor (BICBT-CS)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certified-supervisor): Beck Institute CBT Certified Supervisor (BICBT-CS) certification requirements.
- [CBT Certification for Youth Clinicians (BICBT-CCY)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certification-for-clinicians-working-with-youth): CBT Certification for Youth Clinicians (BICBT-CCY) for adolescent therapy.
- [Work Sample Requirements](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/work-sample): Work sample submission requirements for Beck Institute CBT Certification.

## Professional Training Programs

- [CBT Training Overview](https://beckinstitute.org/training): Beck Institute CBT training programs: workshops, courses, organizational training.
- [Training for Mental Health Professionals](https://beckinstitute.org/training-for-professionals): CBT training for mental health professionals: evidence-based techniques and foundations.
- [On-Demand Online Courses](https://beckinstitute.org/training/training-catalog/about-on-demand-online-training): Self-paced on-demand CBT and CT-R courses for mental health professionals.
- [Beck Institute Live Virtual Workshops](https://beckinstitute.org/beck-institute-live-virtual-workshops): Live Zoom workshops offering direct interaction with Beck Institute CBT experts.
- [On-Demand Webinars](https://beckinstitute.org/training/training-catalog/beck-institute-on-demand-webinars): On-demand webinars covering CBT for autism, ADHD, and mental health conditions.
- [Continuing Education Credits](https://beckinstitute.org/training/continuing-education): Continuing education credits and FAQs for CBT training and certification.

## Specialized Services

- [Training for Organizations](https://beckinstitute.org/training-for-organizations): Organizational CBT and CT-R training program for diverse organizations worldwide.
- [Center for Recovery-Oriented Cognitive Therapy (CT-R)](https://beckinstitute.org/center-for-ct-r): Center for Recovery-Oriented Cognitive Therapy (CT-R) for serious mental illness.
- [CBT Supervision](https://beckinstitute.org/training/supervision): CBT supervision program: individual and group supervision for clinicians.
- [CBT Consultation](https://beckinstitute.org/training/consultation): CBT consultation services for mental health professionals using Cognitive Model.

## Clinical Services

- [Beck Institute Cares Therapy Clinic](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/get-treatment/our-clinic): Beck Institute Cares therapy clinic providing CBT treatment for anxiety, depression, trauma.

## Financial Support

- [Financial Aid for CBT Training](https://beckinstitute.org/training/training-catalog/financial-aid): Financial aid, scholarships, and discounts for CBT training courses.
